summary: Master asset management work processes with our comprehensive CAMA exam preparation training course. Equip yourself for success in the industry.
lede: CAMA exam preparation covers asset management systems, work processes and maturity frameworks relevant to physical-asset decisions. Designed for engineers, assessors, supervisors and technicians, it develops practical skills in applying ISO 55000 concepts, evaluating organizational processes, and using data and risk management to guide maintenance and replacement priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are actively involved in or aspire to work within asset management frameworks.
modules: Day 1: ISO 55000 Asset Management Systems and Standards
Day 2: Frameworks and Models in Asset Management
Day 3: Concepts and Systems in Asset Management
Day 5: Asset Management Models and Maturity Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a foundational understanding of asset management principles and prior exposure to ISO 55000 standards.
